Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A jobs-report article describes mixed relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is an alpine-inspired Swiss eatery offering cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Its website highlights rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content is straightforward, and having your email listed makes it easy for visitors to contact you. I’d suggest adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect from the site—at the moment, the content available to me is quite brief. A few examples of your interests or projects would give it more personality.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning hiking as your favorite hobby gives the blog a personal focus. I’d love to see that expanded into posts about favorite trails, hiking tips, or memorable trips, perhaps with photos. The content available to me is currently very brief, so an introduction explaining what readers can expect would also help.
